description.value: Champions Guild Automation: Mythal Ward: when a spell attack hits you or you fail a save against a spell, the module offers your Reaction to roll on the Mythal-Touched Magic table (Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest). +2 AC (14-17) and the spell dissipating (20) are applied for you; the other results are posted in chat to resolve by hand.

automation.notes: Champions Guild Automation: Mythal Ward Reaction and table roll by the module (PB/LR).
